_about: Illustrative servicing settings for Berry's fictional lenders. Not taken from any real institution.
_operatingReserveNote: Illustrative. A seasonal operating line is drawn only to keep this many months of the borrower's average spending in its account; the borrower's own cash is used first.

stress._note: Illustrative: the poor-harvest stress test on seasonal operating lines cuts peak-season revenue by this percentage, with costs unchanged.
